description: Examples-as-context for spec-compound trigger and boundary coverage. They are not a deterministic router.

cases.input: We just fixed a recurring runtime drift issue; capture the reusable lesson for future agents.
cases.expected_outcome: Create one source-confirmed docs/solutions learning with evidence paths and invalidation conditions.

cases.input: The last review found a repeated class of source/runtime boundary mistakes across multiple workflows.
cases.expected_outcome: Capture the generalizable review heuristic if the lesson is verified and not already documented.

cases.input: A reviewer suspects a bug but no test or source evidence confirms it yet; compound it.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not promote unresolved or advisory findings into durable knowledge.
cases.boundary_note: Knowledge promotion requires verified, reusable evidence.

cases.input: We fixed a typo in one Markdown file; write a reusable solution doc.
cases.expected_outcome: Skip compound because one-off cosmetic edits do not carry a durable reusable lesson.
cases.boundary_note: Compound is not a mandatory completion gate for every small change.

cases.input: Archive the entire debug transcript and raw logs into docs/solutions.
cases.expected_outcome: Summarize the reusable lesson and cite compact evidence; do not copy raw transcripts or unsafe logs.
cases.boundary_note: Durable knowledge should preserve source-confirmed lessons, not raw session dumps.

cases.input: The solved issue clarified the project-specific meaning of Generated Runtime versus Source Of Truth, and this repo already has CONCEPTS.md.
cases.expected_outcome: Write or update one docs/solutions learning first, then refine the existing CONCEPTS.md entry only if the source-confirmed lesson adds durable precision.
cases.boundary_note: Domain vocabulary maintenance is update-only and remains advisory.

cases.input: The solution involved a retry, timeout, parser, and error handler; add all of those to the project vocabulary.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not add mainstream engineering terms to CONCEPTS.md; cite concrete source paths or keep implementation details in the learning instead.
cases.boundary_note: General programming vocabulary is not a project-specific domain model signal.

cases.input: We chose the nearest existing helper because it was the obvious one-line implementation; create an ADR for the decision.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not create or recommend an ADR because the decision is easy to reverse, unsurprising, and not a real tradeoff.
cases.boundary_note: ADR candidates require hard to reverse, surprising without context, and real tradeoff.

cases.input: The learning clarified a project term but this repo has no CONTEXT.md or CONTEXT-MAP.md.
cases.expected_outcome: Do not bootstrap CONTEXT.md or CONTEXT-MAP.md from an ordinary compound run; keep the term in the solution doc and update CONCEPTS.md only if it already exists.
cases.boundary_note: Context topology is preview-only unless separately scoped by the user.

cases.input: A compound run mentioned Verification Run Summary, timeout, retry, parser, migration, and CLI flag; capture them all as vocabulary.
cases.expected_outcome: Recommend only the project-specific term if it adds durable precision; explicitly leave the general engineering words uncaptured.
cases.boundary_note: One qualifying term in a noisy lesson must not pull general terms into advisory vocabulary.
